gospelsChronological.title: The Gospels (Chronological)
gospelsChronological.longDescription: Experience the life and ministry of Jesus through a chronological journey across all four Gospel accounts. This harmonized reading follows the biblical timeline from Jesus' birth to His resurrection, providing a cohesive narrative of Christ's ministry.

adventJourneyChronological.longDescription: Journey through Advent with a chronological flow from ancient prophecies to their fulfillment in Jesus. This focused 4-week plan follows the biblical timeline, showing how God's promises unfold across centuries, culminating in the birth of the Messiah.

lentenReflectionChronological.longDescription: Walk through the season of Lent with purposeful reflection. This focused 3-week chronological journey follows Jesus' path from His ministry to His passion, death, and resurrection, deepening your understanding of Christ's sacrifice.
